clips.title: The story
paras: Along Durotar's coast, Gnomish Tools lie among the wrecks of Proudmoore's fleet. The Horde seeks the salvaged devices to study Alliance engineering and adapt its innovations for survival.

Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore's fleet brought vast supplies of modern equipment to Durotar. Proudmoore led Kul Tiras and Alliance forces to its shores, with sophisticated gear made by their gnomish allies aboard. After the fleet was destroyed along the Scuttle Coast, east of Tiragarde Keep, the delicate mechanical kits sank beneath the waves. Waterproof toolboxes still lie among the rotting timbers and barnacle-encrusted hulls in the shallows.

Gar'Thok, who oversees Razor Hill, sent Horde scouts to recover tools from the watery grave of Proudmoore's navy. The orcs know humans and gnomes are skilled in engineering, especially siege engines, shipwrighting, and clockwork mechanics. They send the kits by caravan to craftsmen and scholars in Orgrimmar. There, the Horde means to study Alliance contraptions, learn to counter enemy war machines, and adapt foreign innovations for its own survival.
